ground_truth: Photoshop 5 for Windows and Macintosh (Visual QuickStart Guide)

gpt-4o-mini.title: Photoshop 5 for Windows and Macintosh (Visual QuickStart Guide)
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: A practical guide by Elaine Weinmann and Peter Lourekas that offers clear, step-by-step instructions for mastering Photoshop 5 on both Windows and Macintosh platforms, making it ideal for beginners and intermediate users. The book emphasizes visual learning with its straightforward layout and helpful illustrations.

gpt-4o-mini.title: Digital Photography: A Beginner's Guide
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: An accessible introduction to digital photography, covering essential concepts and settings.

gpt-4o-mini.title: Illustrator 9 for Windows & Macintosh
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: A comprehensive guide by Elaine Weinmann and Peter Lourekas, this book offers detailed instructions and tips for mastering Illustrator 9 on both Windows and Macintosh platforms, making it an essential resource for graphic designers and digital artists.

gemma2:9b.title: The 7 Deaths of Evelyn Hardcastle

gemma2:9b.title: House of Hollow
gemma2:9b.explanation: A haunting tale about three sisters who share a dark and mysterious past.
